name: eddyter
description: Manage your Eddyter AI rich text editor from Codex: check your license, plan and AI credits, turn editor features on or off live, and get setup code for React, Next.js, Vite and Remix.

interface.longDescription:
Eddyter is an AI rich text editor you can drop into React, Next.js, Vite and Remix apps. This plugin lets you manage your Eddyter account and editor from Codex.

- Check your license: whether it is active, your plan, expiry date and subscription status.
- See your AI credits: credits remaining, credits used this period and when they reset.
- View your editor configuration: which features are on, which are off, and which need a higher plan.
- Turn editor features on or off live (AI chat, tables, comments, image upload, exports and more). Changes reach every user of your editor instantly, with no redeploy.
- Get ready-to-paste setup code for React, Next.js (App or Pages Router), Vite and Remix.

Sign in with your Eddyter account and pick a license key to connect. Which features can be turned on depends on your Eddyter plan. The plugin only accesses the license key you choose when signing in.
capabilities: Turn editor features on or off
defaultPrompt: Which editor features are turned on?
Turn off AI chat in my editor

positive.prompt: Is my Eddyter license active, and when does it expire?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns whether the connected license is valid, its plan name, expiry date and subscription status.

positive.prompt: How many AI credits do I have left this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns credits remaining, credits used this period and the number of days until credits reset.

positive.prompt: Which editor features are turned on in my editor?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists which editor features are enabled, which are off but allowed by the plan, and which are locked behind a higher plan.

positive.prompt: Turn off tables in my editor.
positive.expected_behavior: Turns off the tables feature for the connected license and returns the updated feature configuration. The change is live immediately.

positive.prompt: Give me the code to add the Eddyter editor to my Next.js App Router app.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns install steps and a client-only Next.js App Router component that renders the Eddyter editor.

negative.description: Billing and plan changes are not supported
negative.prompt: Upgrade me to the Pro plan and charge my card.
Show me the license status and credits for another company's Eddyter account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.2: Adds OAuth sign-in settings (dynamic client registration) for the Eddyter MCP server, so users and reviewers can connect with an Eddyter account using email and password.
